note: STD-519 (review round 1: package-level nodes, recursion, application-node keys). The selected document of fixtures/positive-model-tuple-union.json is the full FCD semantic IR 2.0.0 domain-package-acme-shapes.json (STD-529, FR-322-AC-151); domain_package is its projection, the declarations FR-154 reads (tuple_types carry ordered positions, variant_types carry cases, all in document order), and selection_digest is the JCS SHA-256 of the whole document, the digest the lock row pins. Cases are evaluated by the QSpec test over domain_package; wire_cases are RFC 6902 patches over the fixture, each ending by replacing package_id with the recomputed package id. Node names are the declaration_nodes names.
